title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: constantfunc
text:
constant function
constant function
(definition)
Definition:
A
function
that always gives the same value.
See also
0-ary function
,
unary function
,
binary function
,
n-ary function
.
Note:
A 0-ary or nullary function that is pure (no state or interactions with external variables) must be a constant function.
